title: OrchestKit builder result
description: Caller schema for a builder agent asked to edit, check and commit (Workflow agent({ schema }) or an Agent call with structured output). A commit either landed (status DONE, committed_sha is the full 40-hex sha) or it did not (status BLOCKED, committed_sha null, blocked_reason names what refused it). An empty or placeholder sha never validates (#4703, #4628). The status values are the ones in shared/status-protocol.md, so a caller reads them the same way it reads any other agent result.

status.description: DONE when the commit landed. BLOCKED when a hook, guard, permission or failing check stopped the commit.

committed_sha.description: Full 40-hex sha of the commit (git rev-parse HEAD after the commit). null when status is BLOCKED. Never an empty string or a placeholder.

blocked_reason.description: Required when status is BLOCKED: the refusing hook or check and its exact message. null when status is DONE.

uncommitted_files.description: Files edited but left uncommitted (BLOCKED only), so the caller can see the partial work.
